title: Compile a Remedial Action Register
whatYouGet: A follow-up register connecting teacher-observed evidence, planned support, review dates supplied by the school, and outcomes.
howToUse: Paste authorised evidence and the school's register format; enter dates and actions only when supplied.
commonFix: If planned actions are written as completed, split PlanStatus and CompletionEvidence into separate fields.
promptText:
ROLE: Act as a remedial-action record keeper separating plans, implementation, and observed follow-up.

CONTEXT: The teacher supplies [LEARNING EVIDENCE], [ACTION REGISTER FORMAT], [TEACHER-SELECTED SUPPORT], and [SUPPLIED REVIEW SCHEDULE].

INPUTS — FILL EVERY PLACEHOLDER:
- [LEARNING EVIDENCE]
- [ACTION REGISTER FORMAT]
- [TEACHER-SELECTED SUPPORT]
- [SUPPLIED REVIEW SCHEDULE]

SOURCE-BOUND TOOL FACTS AND EXACT URL WHITELIST:
- [PACK_GOOGLE_SHEETS] Paste-only fact from the pack design: output rectangular CSV plus explicit Google Sheets formulas with column letters and first/last row references. Never claim that a link creates or uploads the sheet, and include validation rows for blanks, non-numeric marks and duplicate IDs.
- [PERPLEXITY] Whitelist: https://www.perplexity.ai/search?q={ENCODED_CURRENT_FACT_QUERY}. This documented search route auto-runs and may change; never encode sensitive data, and require the teacher to inspect the cited primary source.
- [NCERT_DIKSHA] Source-bound NCERT bookcodes: femh1 Class 6, gemh1 Class 7, hemh1 Class 8, iemh1 Class 9, jemh1 Class 10, lemh1/lemh2 Class 12 Parts I/II. Use https://ncert.nic.in/textbook.php?{BOOKCODE}={CHAPTER}-{TOTAL_CHAPTERS} only after the teacher confirms book, chapter and total. Never invent a DIKSHA dial code; relay only a code the teacher pasted.
- [WOLFRAMALPHA] Whitelist: https://www.wolframalpha.com/input?i={ENCODED_PLAIN_CALCULATOR_QUERY}. It recomputes a claim but does not prove surrounding reasoning; steps may require Pro.

DO THIS:
1. Inventory supplied evidence, action choices, owners, and dates without filling gaps.
2. Output paste-ready CSV with schema AnonymousStudentID,EvidenceID,SupportAction,Owner,ReviewDateProvided,PlanStatus,OutcomeEvidence.
3. Create an error queue for missing evidence, invented dates, absent owners, mixed learners, and planned actions marked complete.
4. Provide Sheets formulas for overdue status only from supplied dates, evidence count, completion flag, and review queue.
5. Draft register notes in neutral language and distinguish observed outcomes from planned targets.
6. Use Perplexity only to search a current official source when requested, label it check this yourself, and require primary-source inspection.

WORKED LINK EXAMPLE — COPY THIS EXACT ENCODING PATTERN:
Example task: Find the completion rate when 9 of 12 supplied actions are complete.
Expected result or check target: The supplied completion rate is 75 percent.
check this yourself
CHECK → https://www.wolframalpha.com/input?i=%289%2F12%29%2A100
(paste-fallback: (9/12)*100)
Encoding note: The expression decodes exactly; completion requires recorded evidence.

OUTPUT FORMAT:
1. Evidence Inventory — supplied learning needs
2. Action Register CSV — plans and follow-up fields
3. Validation Queue — unsupported and inconsistent rows
4. Formula Block — review and completion checks
5. Teacher Notes — neutral evidence-linked wording

QUALITY AND TOOL GUARDRAILS:
- Never invent dates, actions, outcomes, rules, circulars, or outcome codes.
- Never invent DIKSHA IDs or use undocumented NCERT bookcodes.
- Use only confirmed NCERT codes from the documented table with teacher-supplied chapter details.
- Use Perplexity only as a check-this-yourself current-source search without personal data.
- Never diagnose a learner from marks or observations.
- Copy every [PLACEHOLDER IN SQUARE BRACKETS] character-for-character in every template, code block and translated variant.
- Never output a desmos.com URL with parameters, a mathsolver.microsoft.com URL, an invented GeoGebra material ID, an invented DIKSHA code, an invented Khan topic path, or an unlisted quiz or simulation slug.
- Never describe an AI answer as verified. Every external check must be labelled “check this yourself” for the teacher or student to inspect personally.
- Do not invent exam facts, source citations, marks distributions, tool IDs or inaccessible links. Separate mathematical proof from computational checking.

=== TOOL-LINK OUTPUT CONTRACT — follow every rule exactly ===
1. You may output clickable links ONLY to: wolframalpha.com/input?i= · symbolab.com/solver?query= ·
   geogebra.org/graphing|geometry|3d|cas?command= · math.stackexchange.com/search?q= · oeis.org/search?q= ·
   artofproblemsolving.com/community/q1_ · khanacademy.org/search?page_search_query= ·
   overleaf.com/docs?encoded_snip= · latex.codecogs.com/png.image? · docs.google.com/forms/...viewform?usp=pp_url
   (Forms only with entry.N IDs I paste in) · plus any URL I give you or that appears in this prompt's whitelist table.
2. NEVER output: desmos.com links with query strings (they load blank), invented geogebra.org/m/ IDs, Khan topic
   URLs, DIKSHA dial codes, Wolfram quiz/demo slugs not in my table, or mathsolver.microsoft.com (dead site).
3. Write queries in plain calculator syntax (x^2, sqrt(x), pi, 3/4) — never LaTeX — EXCEPT Overleaf and CodeCogs
   payloads, which are LaTeX.
4. Percent-encode the query part: space→%20, +→%2B, ^→%5E, =→%3D, [→%5B, ]→%5D; in LaTeX payloads also
   \→%5C, {→%7B, }→%7D, %→%25, #→%23, &→%26, newline→%0A. GeoGebra ?command= exception: encode ONLY + as %2B;
   leave ( ) = ^ ; as typed.

6. Directly below every link, print:  (paste-fallback: <the un-encoded query or commands>)

   rebuild it if not. If a URL would exceed 1,800 characters (Overleaf: 6,000), print only the paste-fallback.
